functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow students to distribute a maximum of 100 bidding credits across their ranked elective preferences and validate prerequisite course completions.
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Pass: Credits are allocated accurately and prerequisites are validated. Fail: Total allocated credits exceed 100 or unmet prerequisites are accepted.
functional_requirements.rationale: Ensures students submit valid elective preferences while enforcing bidding-credit and prerequisite constraints.

functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow students to view available elective courses along with relevant course information and eligibility requirements before submitting bids.
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Pass: Eligible elective courses and their requirements are displayed correctly. Fail: Required course information is missing or incorrect.
functional_requirements.rationale: Helps students make informed elective choices.

functional_requirements.description: The system shall validate submitted student bids and prevent invalid bids, including bids that exceed the available bidding credits or violate prerequisite requirements.
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Pass: Invalid bids are rejected with appropriate validation feedback. Fail: An invalid bid is accepted for allocation.
functional_requirements.rationale: Prevents invalid data from entering the allocation process.

functional_requirements.description: The system shall allocate electives based on submitted student bids while resolving allocation constraints and preventing timetable collisions.
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Pass: Allocation satisfies bidding and schedule constraints without timetable collisions. Fail: A student is allocated conflicting electives or allocation constraints are violated.
functional_requirements.rationale: Ensures the final allocation is feasible and conflict-free.

functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow students to view their final elective allocation results after the allocation process is completed.
functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Pass: Students can view their allocated electives accurately. Fail: Results are unavailable or display incorrect allocations.
functional_requirements.rationale: Provides students with clear information about their final elective selections.

non_functional_requirements.description: The final elective allocation solver shall process 5,000 student bids and resolve schedule conflicts in under 30 seconds while maintaining required security standards.
non_functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Pass: Benchmarking confirms processing within 30 seconds and security standards are maintained under simulated peak load. Fail: Processing exceeds 30 seconds or security requirements are not met.
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Ensures the allocation system remains responsive and reliable during peak bidding periods.

non_functional_requirements.description: The system shall maintain accurate student bidding and allocation data throughout the bidding and allocation process and prevent loss or corruption of submitted bids.
non_functional_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Pass: Submitted bids and final allocations remain accurate after processing. Fail: Bids are lost, duplicated, corrupted, or associated with incorrect students.
non_functional_requirements.rationale: Ensures students receive correct allocations based on their actual submitted bids.
